# Instagram Song Finder

> Instagram Song Finder is a free web tool by The Atom that finds the ISRC (International Standard Recording Code) of a song and formats it for Instagram's music search, for example `isrc:USUM72409273`. It is an independent tool and is not affiliated with Instagram, Meta or Spotify.

- Website: https://instagramsongfinder.theatom.lk/
- Publisher: The Atom (https://www.theatom.lk)
- Price: free, no account or sign-in required
- Input accepted: song title, artist name, keywords, Spotify track link, Spotify share link, Spotify URI (`spotify:track:...`), or an ISRC with or without the `isrc:` prefix
- Output: matching recordings with title, artist, album, artwork, release date, length and ISRC, plus a one-click copy of `isrc:<CODE>`
- Data source: the official Spotify Web API where that integration is available; otherwise Deezer's public catalog. Every result is labelled with its source. Codes are never generated or guessed.

## Important limitation

An ISRC identifies one sound recording. It does not show whether Instagram has licensed or indexed that recording. Searching Instagram by ISRC is not an officially documented Instagram feature and may vary by account type, region and app version. The site cannot check Instagram availability.

- [Home and search](https://instagramsongfinder.theatom.lk/): the search tool, a seven-step guide to using an ISRC on Instagram, and frequently asked questions
- [About](https://instagramsongfinder.theatom.lk/about): what the tool does, who publishes it and where its data comes from
- [Privacy](https://instagramsongfinder.theatom.lk/privacy): how searches and technical data are handled
- [Terms of use](https://instagramsongfinder.theatom.lk/terms): conditions for using the service
